cases: TC-1 · REQ-1, REQ-2, AC-1 · windowOverlap({start: "09:00", end: "11:00"}, {start: "10:30", end: "12:00"}) → {overlaps: true, minutes: 30} (earlier end 11:00 minus later start 10:30 = 30)
TC-2 · REQ-3, AC-2 · windowOverlap({start: "09:00", end: "12:00"}, {start: "12:00", end: "13:00"}) → {overlaps: false, minutes: 0} (12:00 minus 12:00 = 0; a shared endpoint is not an overlap)
TC-3 · REQ-4, AC-3 · windowOverlap({start: "10:30", end: "12:00"}, {start: "09:00", end: "11:00"}) → {overlaps: true, minutes: 30} (same pair as AC-1 reversed; 11:00 minus 10:30 = 30)
TC-4 · REQ-2, REQ-3 · windowOverlap({start: "09:00", end: "12:01"}, {start: "12:00", end: "13:00"}) → {overlaps: true, minutes: 1} (one minute past a touch; 12:01 minus 12:00 = 1)

TC-5 · REQ-2, REQ-3 · windowOverlap({start: "09:00", end: "11:59"}, {start: "12:00", end: "13:00"}) → {overlaps: false, minutes: 0} (one minute short of a touch; max(0, 11:59 minus 12:00) = max(0, -1) = 0)
TC-6 · REQ-2, REQ-3 · windowOverlap({start: "08:10", end: "09:40"}, {start: "11:05", end: "12:20"}) → {overlaps: false, minutes: 0} (gap, not a touch; max(0, 09:40 minus 11:05) = max(0, -85) = 0)
TC-7 · REQ-4 · windowOverlap({start: "11:05", end: "12:20"}, {start: "08:10", end: "09:40"}) → {overlaps: false, minutes: 0} (TC-6 reversed; earlier window is second; max(0, 09:40 minus 11:05) = 0)

TC-8 · REQ-2 · windowOverlap({start: "09:00", end: "12:00"}, {start: "10:00", end: "11:30"}) → {overlaps: true, minutes: 90} (inner window second; earlier end 11:30 minus later start 10:00 = 90, not 180)
TC-9 · REQ-4 · windowOverlap({start: "10:00", end: "11:30"}, {start: "09:00", end: "12:00"}) → {overlaps: true, minutes: 90} (TC-8 reversed; inner window first; 11:30 minus 10:00 = 90)
TC-10 · REQ-3, REQ-4 · windowOverlap({start: "12:00", end: "13:00"}, {start: "09:00", end: "12:00"}) → {overlaps: false, minutes: 0} (AC-2 reversed; 12:00 minus 12:00 = 0)

TC-11 · REQ-2, REQ-3 · windowOverlap({start: "13:00", end: "15:00"}, {start: "14:00", end: "14:01"}) → {overlaps: true, minutes: 1} (smallest positive overlap; 14:01 minus 14:00 = 1, not the outer 120)
TC-12 · REQ-2 · windowOverlap({start: "00:00", end: "00:40"}, {start: "00:25", end: "01:10"}) → {overlaps: true, minutes: 15} (day-start bound; 00:40 minus 00:25 = 15)
TC-13 · REQ-2 · windowOverlap({start: "22:10", end: "23:50"}, {start: "23:40", end: "23:59"}) → {overlaps: true, minutes: 10} (day-end bound; earlier end 23:50 minus later start 23:40 = 10)
TC-14 · REQ-4 · windowOverlap({start: "23:40", end: "23:59"}, {start: "22:10", end: "23:50"}) → {overlaps: true, minutes: 10} (TC-13 reversed; 23:50 minus 23:40 = 10)
TC-15 · unknown field on the first window · windowOverlap({start: "09:00", end: "11:00", driver: "A"}, {start: "10:30", end: "12:00"}) → throws Error "unknown field: driver"
TC-16 · unknown field on the second window · windowOverlap({start: "09:00", end: "11:00"}, {start: "10:30", end: "12:00", priority: "high"}) → throws Error "unknown field: priority"
